race.comment: Good little sprint to finish. Siding with the resuming NOETZIE (15) who looked awesome winning by nearly five lengths in fast time at Murray Bridge two starts ago. That saw him start $2.90 in a stronger race at Caulfield where he ran a solid fourth. Off a very long break here but he's won a couple of jumpouts and can win this fresh. HEADBANGER (10) is a speedy mare who won on the synthetic here two back, okay over 955m at Cranbourne when unable to find the front. She'll give a sight. LANDMARK (3) will find this a fair bit easier than the Century Stakes behind Rey Magnerio first up. He'll get back but be charging home. BARARI (1) resumes with a solid profile, 1000m looks okay for her but she does pay a bit at the weights. YOLO (9) is a handy mare with each way claims.
